Sandbox_EnshroudedSleepClockSpike_Enable: When some but not all living players are asleep, compress world/calendar time by changing MinutesPerDay. Vanilla Project Zomboid still controls sleep eligibility and full-sleep fast-forward.
Sandbox_EnshroudedSleepClockSpike_Partia: Scales the server FastForwardMultiplier for partial sleep only. 1.0 is neutral, 0.5 halves the partial-sleep compression, and 2.0 doubles it. The mod never changes the global simulation multiplier.
